svg.title: CONTAINERS & K8S
svg.desc: Containers and Kubernetes: a Flask microservice deployed as 5 replicas behind a LoadBalancer Service on Minikube, with images published to Docker Hub (suriya4code/python-flask-microservice and suriya4code/flask-ocr). Maps to EKS/ECS at work.

g.text: 5 REPLICAS · MINIKUBE · IMAGES ON DOCKER HUB
